Config order: keyringsrc = vouch: first, then the legacy GPG keyring (e.g. korg-pgpkeys .keyring); patatt already tries sources in order (src/patatt/__init__.py:1652-1657) and openpgp signatures already fall through to gpg. Fallback applies to everyone, registered or not. Removal = delete the legacy keyringsrc line after the late cutoff; no code change.
